title: Notification shows delta ??? with Native Mode when there are backfills
body: In g5 native mode, if readings are missed and then a new reading is obtained and the backfill is successful, the persistent notification still shows "Delta: ???" when it should be able to recalculate the delta from the old values as is done in the main app activity.

comments.body:
Hi,

As recently as this week I've noticed that this issue still occurs. I'm running an xDrip release from 12/29/2020 -- so not entirely up to date, but from scanning through the commit history it doesn't look like there have been any changes related to this since then.

@jwoglom What do you mean by the following?
"as is done in the main app activity"

@jwoglom 
Does this not happen with the Dexcom app?
